verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap publishes a versioning and deprecation policy for its Jobs, x402 and Edge APIs. Versions are set in the URL path under Semantic Versioning, breaking changes ship as a new path version, and removal of any API version comes with at least six months' notice. Per-API changelogs and /v2/ endpoints back this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation policy is honored in practice, and documentation of in-band deprecation signals (e.g., deprecation headers).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: We release breaking changes as a new version in the URL path
